question: 'The Stars in My Sky : Those Who Brightened My Film Journey' is the second book of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Divya Dutta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'The Stars in My Sky : Those Who Brightened My Film Journey' is the second book of Indian actress and model **Divya Dutta.**
 
• Dutta has appeared in Hindi and Punjabi cinema, in addition to Malayalam and English-language films.
 
• She has received many awards including a **National Film Award in 2018** – National Film Award for Best Supporting Actress – **Irada**, a Filmfare OTT Award and 2 IIFA Awards.
 
• She wrote a **memoir**,** Me and Ma,** about her heavenly relationship with her mother.
